name: 53168 · Salem, WI
findings: ZIP 53168 (Salem) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53168 (Salem) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 53168 (Salem) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).
